messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — customer Wyvern (enterprise VPC) reports spike in 5xxs for model endpoint 'wyvern-prod-gen' using variant v3-quant. Impact: ~30% error rate, elevated latency. Incident P1. Link: https://rwd/in/INC-1758
ash: Oncall SRE here, reading logs now. I can confirm increased 502/504 from grpc workers on nodes in cluster-eu-2.
mike_oncall_ml: Taking ML oncall — I'll check model runtime traces and KV cache. ash — if you can paste the worker logs that would help.
ash: quick log snippet: ```
worker-14 | OOM when allocating kv_cache 12.1GiB at step 4382
worker-14 | fallback -> 502 serving error
```
zoe_infra: Noted. I see memory pressure across a subset of dedicated pool GPUs for this tenant. Autoscaler didn't spin new nodes because reserved capacity constraints blocked burst.
lina_prodops: Olga (AM) looped in; customer-facing comms needed. Olga, do they have active SLA for 99.9 latency/uptime?
olga_am: Confirmed, Wyvern has enterprise SLA. They're seeing degraded UX. Please prioritize mitigation and frequency of updates every 15m.
mike_oncall_ml: Hypothesis: v3-quant is regressing under long-sequence traffic. There's a safe variant v2-long (higher mem but stable) in the catalog. Two possible mitigations: 1) pin Wyvern to v2-long (safe-variant) for affected route, or 2) rollforward to v3-quant with reduced max_seq / trigger auto-truncate which reduces memory but may affect quality.
nash: For immediate containment, I can patch the routing rule to divert 100% of Wyvern traffic to the safe variant (v2-long) in the VPC route table. That will increase token cost but restore stability.
zoe_infra: We need a temporary exception to reserved-capacity burst gating to allow a single extra worker for that tenant while we reroute. Requesting override now.
nash: Command to change tenant routing (will run after handoff): ```sh
# switch tenant wyvern to safe variant
redwoodctl route update --tenant wyvern --route /gen --model wyvern-model:v2-long --force-override
```
mike_oncall_ml: If we pin the model, we should also disable the quantized path for that tenant to avoid repeated memory pressure. Suggest config flag: disable_quant_for_tenant: wyvern = true
lina_prodops: I'll own the customer updates. Plan: immediate mitigation (reroute to v2-long + one extra worker), then evaluate log/trace stability for 30m, then decide on longer-term: rollforward with model engineering or keep pinned until next deploy window.
olga_am: Customer requests ETA and a note on expected quality delta. Lina, pls include a short note: "You may see a slight shift in outputs; this preserves availability."
nash: I'll apply routing change now and post back with evidence.
deploy-bot: Deploy plan submitted: change-route:wyvern -> v2-long (dry-run passed)
ash: Applied route update at 1758888932. Observed immediate drop in 5xxs from 32% -> 3% on sampled traffic. CPU/mem stabilized on workers.
mike_oncall_ml: KV cache miss pattern changed as expected. Latency improved. Quality regression TBD but within acceptable bounds per quick eval on 50 requests.
zoe_infra: Override to allow one extra worker approved and provisioned at 1758888950.
lina_prodops: First customer update sent at 1758888960. Next update scheduled +15m.
nash: Closing immediate blast radius. Next actions: (1) run extended evaluation on pinned variant for 2h, (2) decide on permanent pin vs engineered fix, (3) create retrospective and action items.
mike_oncall_ml: Action item: coordinate with model team to reproduce memory spike on v3-quant with long sequences. Ticket created: ML-4281.
olga_am: Customer acknowledged and is monitoring. Thanks team.
nash: Marking incident as mitigated — will remain in watch for 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
incidents-bot: Incident INC-1758 status -> mitigated (watching). Pager will resume if errors >5% for 5m.
